episodes.title: Act 1
episodes.summary: Jeongnyeon is a gifted singer. Desperate to escape her life, she discovers the world of gukgeuk.

episodes.title: Act 2
episodes.summary: Jeongnyeon is accepted into Maeran Gukgeukdan and must now prove she deserves to stay.

episodes.title: Act 3
episodes.summary: As she struggles to play a character, Jeong-nyeon faces a sudden crisis during her first performance.

episodes.title: Act 4
episodes.summary: It's discovered that Jeong-nyeon works at the coffee shop. She then discovers Young-seo's secret.

episodes.title: Act 5
episodes.summary: Jeong-nyeon is shocked about her mother's secret and Jong-kook's ill intent right before her debut.

episodes.title: Act 6
episodes.summary: Jeong-nyeon feels strange about Joo-ran and Young-seo getting closer and makes a huge mistake on stage.

episodes.title: Act 7
episodes.summary: Banned from performing, Jeong0nyeon realizes her mistake. Meanwhile, Joo-ran is unexpectedly injured.

episodes.title: Act 8
episodes.summary: The pressure from the audition becomes too much for Jeong-nyeon, and she makes a dangerous choice.

episodes.title: Act 9
episodes.summary: Jeong-nyeon collapses and several issues within and out of Maeran jeopardize the joint performance.

episodes.title: Act 10
episodes.summary: So-bok and Young-seo pour out their feelings in Mokpo. Yong-rye makes a brave decision for Jeong-nyeon.

episodes.title: Act 11
episodes.summary: Jeong-nyeon returns to a troupe in disarray. So-bok collapses and Joo-ran makes an announcement.

episodes.title: Act 12
episodes.summary: Curtains rise on Jeong-nyeon and Young-seo's final competition to decide the new gukgeuk prince.
